title: LoadRulesResult
description: Structured result from WASM load_rules (PRD §11.9): success/partial/failure counts and per-rule load errors.

ok.description: Whether the load attempt completed in an overall success path (see errors for per-rule issues).

rules_version.description: Integer revision from the loaded ruleset payload (PRD §11.9). Narrower than ruleset input rules_version typing when the payload used a string.

rule_count.description: Number of rules present in the ruleset array submitted to load_rules.

compiled_rule_count.description: Number of rules successfully compiled into the active ruleset.

skipped_rule_count.description: Number of rules skipped (e.g. invalid); see errors for detail.

errors.description: Structured errors from load/compile; empty on full success.

errorInfo.description: Same shape as error-info.schema.json; required code and message, optional rule_id and field.
